figurative_meaning_en: Bossy or authoritative demeanor; acting like an elder or superior
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ছোট ভাইদের সামনে জেঠামি করে।
অফিসে বস জেঠামি দেখাতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He puts on a jethami attitude in front of his younger siblings.
The boss doesn't want to show jethami behavior in the office.
note: Derived from 'জেঠা' (paternal uncle), reflecting traditional joint family structures in Bengali culture
